GUIDE_CARD_0_CONTENT:
The ordeal unfolds in an unyielding diurnal rhythm divided into critical phases:

• DAWN / MORNING: A brief respite after nocturnal onslaught. Receive casualty assessments, production balance reports, and daily resource tallies.

• DUSK: Final preparations before twilight. Calibrate targeting priorities, position garrisons, and stockpile munition reserves.

• NIGHT: The Corrupted Miasma spawns nightmarish hordes surging toward the sacred Stronghold Gate. Defense towers engage hostiles automatically.
GUIDE_CARD_0_TITLE: Day and Night Cycle of the Stronghold
GUIDE_CARD_1_CONTENT:
The Stronghold unites three divergent races, each wielding unique operational proficiencies:

• DWARVES: Master smiths, stone-hewers, and steam engineers. Irreplaceable inside deep mines and heavy machinery.

• ELVES: Attuned to raw ether magic and nature. Yield peak efficiency in timber mills, mystical towers, and research institutes.

• HUMANS: Adaptable artisans, logistics organizers, and scouts.

• EXPEDITION CENTER: Dispatch scouts deep into uncharted fog to clear hexes and secure rich mineral veins.
GUIDE_CARD_2_CONTENT:
The Beacon is the beating heart of the stronghold and our ultimate bulwark against corruption:

• SACRED FLAME: Divine radiance repels thick miasma vapors, dulling enemy ferocity and dampening demonic vitality.

• FUEL PROVISIONS: Strictly monitor coal and wood reserves. Allowing the beacon to extinguish drastically invigorates attacking fiends!

• HOPE SYSTEM: Enduring nights and accomplishing expeditions generates Hope, the catalyst for lasting fortress meta-upgrades.
GUIDE_CARD_3_CONTENT:
Survival hinges on specialized fortifications:

• GUARD ARBALEST: Standard long-range kinetic engine picking off advance skirmishers.

• ROYAL BOMBARD: High-caliber siege mortar delivering armor-shattering explosive shells against dense enemy hordes.

• STEAM REPEATER: Clockwork rotary weapon maintaining intense suppressive fire against swift predators.

• SHADOW SPIRE: Occult obelisk unleashing heavy magical damage against eldritch abominations.

Remember: Every tower demands construction resources and continuous daily upkeep!
